japanese: 盆と正月が一緒に来たよう
kana: ぼんとしょうがつがいっしょにきたよう
meanings: as if Christmas and one's birthday had come at the same time
as if Lady Luck had just visited twice

kana: ばんかんむねにせまる
meanings: to be filled with thousand emotions
to be overwhelmed by a flood of emotions

japanese: 無理が通れば道理が引っ込む
kana: むりがとおればどうりがひっこむ
meanings: where might is master, justice is servant

japanese: 名の無い星は宵から出る
kana: なのないほしはよいからでる
meanings: the worst goes foremost
those one eagerly await will not arrive first

kana: なはたいをあらわす
meanings: names and natures do often agree

kana: いのちながければはじおおし
meanings: to live long is to outlive much
the longer you live, the more shame you suffer

kana: いのちあってのものだね
meanings: while there is life, there is hope
without life, there is nothing

japanese: 明日のことを言えば鬼が笑う
kana: あすのことをいえばおにがわらう
meanings: nobody knows the morrow
speak of tomorrow and the ogres laugh

japanese: 明日の百より今日の五十
kana: あすのひゃくよりきょうのごじゅう
meanings: a bird in the hand is worth two in the bush
fifty today is better than a hundred tomorrow

japanese: 明日は明日の風が吹く
kana: あしたはあしたのかぜがふく
meanings: tomorrow will take care of itself
let the morn come and the meat with it

kana: めがでる
meanings: to have luck on one's side
to get lucky

kana: めどがたつ
meanings: the prospects look brighter
there is hope of accomplishing (something)

kana: めあきせんにんめくらせんにん
meanings: some are wise and some are otherwise
one thousand with their eyes open; one thousand blind

kana: くすりよりようじょう
meanings: prevention is better than cure

kana: わけあり
meanings: having special circumstances (e.g. problems, issues, advantages, flaws, defects, etc.)
imperfect (merchandise)

japanese: 柳の下にいつも泥鰌はいない
kana: やなぎのしたにいつもどじょうはいない
meanings: a fox is not taken twice in the same snare
there are no birds in last year's nest

japanese: 夕焼けは晴れ朝焼けは雨
kana: ゆうやけははれあさやけはあめ
meanings: red sky at night, shepherd's delight; red sky in the morning, shepherd's warning

japanese: 余の辞書に不可能という文字はない
kana: よのじしょにふかのうというもじはない
meanings: the word impossible is not in my dictionary

kana: あまりものにふくがある
meanings: do not despair because you are the last to take your pick
you can find treasures in leftovers

kana: ざまあみろ
meanings: serves you right!
see what happens!

japanese: 用心に越したことはない
kana: ようじんにこしたことはない
meanings: you can never be too careful
you can't be too cautious

kana: いらざるおせわ
meanings: that's none of your business

japanese: 来年のことを言うと鬼が笑う
kana: らいねんのことをいうとおにがわらう
meanings: nobody knows the morrow
speak of next year and the ogres laugh

kana: うらがある
meanings: to have a catch
to have an ulterior motive

kana: りゅうこあいうつ
meanings: a fight between equally great opponents
dragon and tiger fighting one another
